name: hybrid-4d2o-n256-normalized
description: 16x16 torus + 2 OCS planes, N=256, same normalized units as hybrid-4d2o-n64-normalized (93.132 GiB/s per direction, 25 ns direct, 55 ns OCS whole-path, T_r 10 ns sensitivity assumption); the panel builder's torus2d at 256 nodes. Panel-scale serving capability run.
